questions.q: Why did United States Treasury yields fall in the market session?
o: Federal Reserve official Waller made dovish remarks that shifted policy expectations.

questions.e: Officials stated that government demands to finance fiscal deficits pose the primary threat to central bank independence. They did not cite inflation, property lending, or retail banking technology as the primary institutional threat.
